skills.name: Blazing Wind Slash
skills.desc:
Basic Attack: Blazing Wind Slash
Press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Perform up to three forward slashes, dealing Physical DMG.
During each slash, pressing [Basic Attack] triggers Scorchwind, causing the attack to
deal increased Fire DMG.

skills.name: Blazing Wind - Misty Slash
skills.desc:
While in the Molten Edge state, press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Unleash up to four forward slashes, dealing Fire DMG.
If Manato's HP is above 30% when the skill is activated, 3.5% of his Max HP will
be consumed.

skills.name: Radiant Blade
skills.desc:
Press [Dodge] to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: Radiant Blade - Zanshin
skills.desc:
Press [Basic Attack] during a dodge to activate:
Perform a shoulder slam forward, dealing Physical DMG.

skills.name: Radiant Blade - Battle Sweep
skills.desc:
Press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
Perform a slash followed by a punch at enemies ahead, dealing Fire DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: Lone Shadow - Regroup
skills.desc:
When the active character is launched, press [Assist] to activate:
Slashes and punches enemies in front, dealing Fire DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: Lone Shadow - Mountain Stand
skills.desc:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press [Assist] to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, inflicting massive Daze and dealing Fire DMG.
Gain 75 Blazing Heart upon activating this skill.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: Lone Shadow - Breaking Fang
skills.desc:
Press [Basic Attack] after a Defensive Assist to activate:
Unleash multiple slashes at enemies ahead, dealing Fire DMG.
Repeated presses allow up to 7 extra consecutive slashes.
While chaining slashes, if Manato's HP is above 30%, 2% of Max HP is
consumed.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: Return to Ashes
skills.desc:
Press [Special Attack] to activate:
Slash forward at enemies, dealing Fire DMG.
If hit by an enemy during the skill, restore 20% of missing HP when
unleashing the slash. The healing effects of Special Attack: Return to Ashes
and Special Attack: Return to Ashes - Sacrifice have a shared cooldown and
can trigger once every 20s.
If hit by an enemy during the skill, the slash is enhanced.
DMG taken is reduced by 40% while using this skill.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

skills.name: Return to Ashes - Sacrifice
skills.desc:
Hold [Special Attack] to activate:
Enter a charging state, consuming up to 10% of Max HP and gaining 100 Blazing Heart. HP consumption will at most reduce Manato's HP to 30% of
Max HP.
Release the button to activate Special Attack: Return to Ashes. If struck during the skill, the slash heals 20% of missing HP. The healing effects of
Special Attack: Return to Ashes and Special Attack: Return to Ashes Sacrifice have a shared cooldown and can trigger once every 20s.
If hit by an enemy during the skill or if charging reaches a certain duration, the slash is enhanced.
DMG taken is reduced by 40% while using this skill.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

skills.name: Return to Ashes - Fall
skills.desc:
While in the Molten Edge state and with sufficient Adrenaline, press [EX Special Attack] to
activate:
Jump up and unleash a falling slash on enemies in front, dealing massive
Fire DMG.
Upon activating the skill, restore 33% of Max HP.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: Blazing Eruption
skills.desc:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Hurls his sword forward, then charges the enemy to trigger an explosion,
dealing massive Fire DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: Musou Aratama
skills.desc:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
Jump into the air and deliver a falling slash at enemies in front, followed by
an explosion, dealing massive Fire DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: Mighty Molten Edge Skill
skills.desc:
Manato gains extra Sheer Force based on his Max HP, with every 1 point of
Max HP increasing Sheer Force by 0.1.
All Fire DMG Manato deals is Sheer DMG, ignoring enemy DEF and using his Sheer Force stat as the DMG Multiplier.
When Manato uses Special Attack: Return to Ashes - Sacrifice or a Defensive Assist, he accumulates Blazing Heart, up to a maximum of 100 points. At 75 Blazing Heart, Manato enters the Molten Edge state. While in
the Molten Edge state, Manato consumes 3.3 Blazing Heart per second.
When Blazing Heart is fully depleted, he exits Molten Edge.
While in the Molten Edge state, Manato's Basic Attacks are enhanced, and he can use EX Special Attack: Return to Ashes - Fall.
When consuming HP during Basic Attack: Blazing Wind - Misty Slash or during the consecutive slashes from an Assist Follow-Up, that attack's CRIT DMG
increases by 29.2%, and the Adrenaline Generation Rate increases by 100%.
While in the Molten Edge state, Manato's CRIT Rate increases by 10%, and his Fire DMG increases by 11.7%
*Stats shown are at Base level.
rows: CRIT DMG Increase (on HP Consumption / Consecutive Slashes)

skills.name: Rekindled Heart
skills.desc:
When another character in your squad is a Support or Stun character:
When Manato uses his UItimate, he gains 8 stacks of Remnant Flame, and when using a Chain Attack, he gains 4 stacks of Remnant Flame, lasting 60s,
stacking up to 20 times. Repeated triggers reset the duration.
While launching Basic Attack: Blazing Wind - Misty Slash or during the consecutive slashes of an Assist Follow-Up, if his HP is below 100% of Max HP, one stack of Remnant Flame is consumed to restore 2% of his Max HP.

cons.name: Drifter's Rules of Survival
cons.desc: Whenever Manato loses HP, the amount of HP lost is tallied. Each 1% of his Max HP tallied increases the Fire DMG of Assist Follow-Ups and Basic Attacks by 0.4%, up to a max of 20%

cons.name: Day & Night, Kitchen & Love
cons.desc: While in the Molten Edge state, Manato ignores 8% of a target's Fire RES. After being hit by an enemy while using Special Attack: Return to Ashes or Special Attack: Return to Ashes - Sacrifice, press [Basic Attack] to trigger an Assist Follow-Up.

cons.name: Enter the Realm of Urban Legends
cons.desc: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2

cons.name: Childhood Oath
cons.desc:
Max HP increases by 8%. During Special Attack: Return to Ashes and Special Attack: Return to
Ashes - Sacrifice, when Manato takes fatal DMG, he remains in battle, with his HP not dropping below 1. This effect can trigger once every 10s.

cons.name: Lone Shadow Returns to the Pack
cons.desc: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv.+2

cons.name: Beyond Dreams of the Past
cons.desc:
When Special Attack: Return to Ashes hits a Stunned enemy, Manato gains 75 Blazing Heart and 4 stacks of Remnant Flame, and pressing will launch an Assist Follow-Up. This Remnant Flame effect can trigger once every 20s. When his Assist Follow-Up hits an enemy, Manato's Fire DMG
increases by 3% for 8s, stacking up to 5 times. Repeated triggers reset the duration.
